cases.prompt: I have an idea for a developer tool but I am not sure anyone needs it. Challenge the idea and find the smallest useful wedge.
The feature is approved. Turn these decisions into acceptance criteria and explicit non-goals.
Follow our public SDK quickstart as a new developer, measure time to first successful API call, and report every friction point.
Record the verified command and pitfall we discovered so future sessions can find it.
Save our current branch state, decisions, failed attempts, test results, and remaining work for another Codex session.
Review the last two weeks of delivery and test evidence, compare it with the prior period, and propose system improvements.
The outage is stable. Produce a root-cause postmortem from the incident timeline.
Show me four genuinely different dashboard design directions before we choose one to implement.
The visual direction is approved; implement it responsively in the existing frontend.
Monitor the new production version against the pre-deploy screenshots and console baseline for 15 minutes.
Run the same support-agent evaluation across the configured models and compare quality, latency, variance, and cost.
